notes: Nine facts: six from the 2025 Remittances Household Survey (flows, source shares, encashment cost), M-PESA Global's published corridor list plus the explicit negative that Nigeria is not on it, and two PAPSS scheme facts. No FX rate or live pricing is asserted.

KNBS / Central Bank of Kenya / FSD Kenya, 2025 Remittances Household Survey Report

entries.subject: remittance_inflows
entries.display: KSh 931.8 billion of remittance inflows, June 2024 - May 2025
entries.quote: households in kenya received a total of ksh 931 8 billion in remittance inflows during the reference period june 2024 to may 2025
entries.notes: Survey reference period June 2024 to May 2025. Cash transfers 91.0%, in-kind 9%.

entries.subject: remittance_outflows
entries.display: KSh 40.5 billion of remittance outflows in the same period
entries.quote: households in kenya sent a total of ksh 40 5 billion in remittances during the reference period
entries.notes: Over two thirds of outflows went to students abroad.

entries.subject: largest_remittance_source_share
entries.display: The United States supplied 43.5% of inflows, the largest single source
entries.quote: the united states of america was the largest source of inflows contributing 43 5 per cent of total remittances followed by germany and australia

entries.subject: formal_channel_share
entries.display: Banks and mobile money carried over 92.0% of inflows
entries.quote: formal channels remain the preferred mode for remittance transfers with banks and mobile money platforms accounting for over 92 0 per cent of inflows

entries.subject: remittance_encashment_cost
entries.display: Average cost of cashing out KSh 1,000 received from the top 20 source countries: about KSh 8
entries.quote: on average the cost of encashing the equivalent of ksh 1 000 from the top 20 source countries accounting for 96 0 per cent of the total cash remittance inflows was about ksh 8 0 representing less than 1 0 per cent of the transaction value
entries.notes: Not the sending cost: this is the payout-side encashment cost measured on remittances already received.

entries.subject: mpesa_global_corridors
entries.value_text: East Africa: Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Botswana, Burundi, Zambia, Malawi. Asia: Bangladesh, Pakistan
entries.display: M-PESA Global send-to-mobile destinations listed by Safaricom
entries.quote: m pesa customers will be able to send funds to east africa rwanda tanzania uganda botswana and burundi zambia and malawi to asia bangladesh and pakistan
entries.notes: Inbound is wider than outbound: 'm pesa registered customers can also receive funds from abroad on their mpesa account'. enum_match set: {East Africa: Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Botswana, Burundi, Zambia, Malawi. Asia: Bangladesh, Pakistan}.

entries.subject: nigeria_corridor_available
entries.display: No direct M-PESA Global send-to-mobile corridor to Nigeria is listed
entries.quote: m pesa customers will be able to send funds to east africa rwanda tanzania uganda botswana and burundi zambia and malawi to asia bangladesh and pakistan
entries.notes: Negative fact. The eligible-destination list contains no West African country and no Nigeria; a Kenya-to-Nigeria payment must route through a bank, PesaLink is domestic-only, or a third-party remittance provider. Do not describe it as a direct mobile-money rail.

entries.subject: papss_definition
entries.value_text: A pan-African cross-border financial market infrastructure for payments between African countries
entries.display: PAPSS is continental settlement infrastructure, not a consumer wallet
entries.quote: papss the pan african payment and settlement system is a cross border financial market infrastructure enabling payment transactions across africa
entries.notes: Participants are banks, payment service providers and switches; the site lists no consumer-facing wallet.

entries.subject: papss_settlement_currency
entries.value_text: Originator pays in their own local currency and the beneficiary receives in theirs
entries.display: PAPSS settles in local currencies rather than requiring a hard-currency leg
entries.quote: instant payments instant payments made by originators to beneficiaries in their local currencies no matter where they are in africa
entries.notes: The PAPSS site carries no date; effective_from is the capture date.
